findings.description: The KMS key used to encrypt the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so the same key material is used indefinitely. Long-lived key material increases the blast radius if the key is ever compromised and weakens cryptoperiod controls for audit log data.

No explicit key policy is defined, so the key falls back to the default policy granting the AWS account root full control, which allows any IAM principal in the account that can be granted kms:* to use or administer the key. For a key protecting audit/CloudTrail data this should be a least-privilege policy restricting decrypt and administrative actions to specific principals.
